description: LANGUAGE_BUG regression (found during reject-redundant-call-borrows round-2 pins, 2026-07-29): a qualified call on a parameterized trait instantiated at a REFERENCE type argument (Taker<&String>::take) failed impl lookup with 'no implementation for trait ... on receiver Sink' while the identical shape at Taker<Int> resolved.
